story.iWant: to reimplement the SMA Crossover strategy for rustybt using rustybt's actual indicator library and order API
story.soThat: the strategy executes through rustybt's real engine and serves as the reference pattern for reimplementing the remaining strategies

task.title: Analyze Current Implementation
task.subtask: Identify deque-based manual SMA calculation to replace
Document current parameter names (fast, slow, target)

task.title: Locate rustybt SMA Indicator
task.subtask: Find SMA in rustybt's indicator library

task.title: Implement New SMA Crossover Strategy
task.subtask: Implement crossover detection using rustybt indicators
Use rustybt's order API for trade execution

task.title: Implement Logging
task.subtask: Log Layer 1 events (bar_received) via base class
Log Layer 2 events (SMA values) via log_signal()
Log Layer 3 events (order_created) via order wrappers

criterion.title: Use rustybt's SMA indicator (not deque-based manual calculation)
criterion.requirement: Import SMA from rustybt's indicator library
No manual moving average calculations with deque/collections

criterion.title: Use rustybt's order API (not _execute_order)
criterion.requirement: Use order(), order_target(), or order_percent() from rustybt
Orders flow through rustybt's broker simulation

criterion.title: Same number of trades as Backtrader
criterion.requirement: Trade count should match between frameworks

criterion.title: SMA values match (Layer 2 comparison)
criterion.requirement: Allow for warmup period differences (document as DESIGN if needed)

constraints.constraint: Must use rustybt's native SMA indicator, not manual deque calculation
Must use rustybt's order API, not _execute_order
Must log Layer 1-5 events for comparison
Establishes reference pattern for X.6 strategies

tests.standards: pytest validation tests. Compare against Backtrader implementation.

ideas.idea: Verify no deque imports in strategy code
Verify no _execute_order calls in strategy code
Compare SMA values via Layer 2 test
